logline: 숲으로 달아난 활잡이가, 지나는 부자들의 짐을 가난한 마을로 돌린다.
destination: 셔우드 숲 한복판 — 관군도 함부로 들어오지 못하는 곳
protagonist: 초록 두건을 쓴 서른 살 활잡이
anchor: a lean archer of thirty in a green hood and leather jerkin, longbow across his back
palette: forest green, oak brown, autumn ochre, warm amber, cold pale grey

robin.label: 활잡이
robin.desc: a lean English archer of thirty, short beard, green hood and leather jerkin, longbow, quiver at his hip

sheriff_men.label: 관군
sheriff_men.desc: English soldiers in mail coats and flat helmets, red surcoats, spears and kite shields

villagers.label: 마을 사람들
villagers.desc: English peasants in undyed wool tunics and hoods, worn boots, weathered faces

forest.label: 셔우드 숲
forest.desc: a dense oak forest, huge mossy trunks, ferns underfoot, low green light

market.label: 노팅엄 장터
market.desc: a crowded medieval market square, timber stalls, canvas awnings, castle wall behind

beats.visual: a green-hooded archer slipping between huge mossy oak trunks into deep forest
beats.motion: he moves forward into the trees away from the road, ferns close behind him

beats.visual: a green-hooded archer drawing a longbow toward a straw target in a crowded market square
beats.motion: the bowstring draws back to his cheek, the crowd leans in, awnings flap overhead

beats.visual: mailed soldiers in red surcoats pushing through market stalls, spears above the crowd
beats.motion: they push forward through the stalls, a stall topples, produce rolls across the stones

beats.visual: a green-hooded archer running between oak trunks, branches whipping past him
beats.motion: he runs deeper into the forest away from the camera, branches whip back, leaves burst

beats.visual: a green-hooded archer crouched on a thick oak branch above a forest track, bow ready
beats.motion: he settles low on the branch, leaves shift around him, light dapples the track

beats.visual: a laden cart with mounted escorts entering a narrow forest track between oaks
beats.motion: the cart rolls forward down the track, harness jingles, ferns bend at the wheels

beats.visual: peasants in wool tunics taking heavy sacks at a forest edge at dawn, breath steaming
beats.motion: the sacks pass forward into their arms, breath clouds rise, dew shakes off the grass

beats.visual: an empty forest track with deep cart ruts filling with morning mist, oaks above
beats.motion: mist settles into the ruts, oak leaves turn overhead, light spreads down the track

withheld: 활잡이의 본디 이름과 신분, 그리고 왕이 돌아와 내리는 결정
